label: European model options on historical underlying prices

book.construction_rule: All ten core-panel issuers are held, so no issuer is chosen or dropped. Side is assigned by business line: deposit-funded commercial and universal banks are long, capital-markets, brokerage and custody franchises are short. Weights are equal within each side. This is a fixed risk-bearing mandate for studying overlays, not an alpha view.
book.rebalance_rule: Reset to target weights at each window start from the decision close, whole shares truncated toward zero. No trading inside a window.

windows.rule: Consecutive non-overlapping windows anchored at the first eligible session of each split. Each window is a separate account opened with the same capital. A window ending after its split is dropped, never truncated.

execution.option_execution: model value, no option bid/ask charge (replay limitation)
execution.rate_interpretation: Constant illustrative rate used for cash, borrowing and option pricing, not a historical rate series.

estimation.pricing_volatility: Sample standard deviation of the 252 log returns ending at the decision close, times sqrt(252). This is an option-pricing assumption, not an observed implied volatility.
estimation.risk_estimates: Past-only EWMA and 252-session book variance and past-only XLF betas. These choose protection size and never price an option.
estimation.beta: Sample covariance with XLF over variance of XLF on the 252 log returns ending at the decision close.

risk_informed.rule: Spend the mandate budget when book EWMA volatility / book 252-session volatility, both known at the decision close, is at or above the threshold. Otherwise spend half of it. Labelled price-history-informed, not a validated macro or funding forecast.

selection.eligibility: Annual budget no greater than the mandate budget. The 4% budget is a frontier point only.
selection.tie_break: Lower mean net premium, then label.

sensitivity.sizing_rule: Budget stays fixed, so a higher pricing volatility buys less coverage. Selected policies are re-evaluated without reselection.

uncertainty.method: Circular moving-block bootstrap over chronological window-level paired differences. Issuers are aggregated within a window, so names in one episode are never separate observations.
